domain: Only CoreProgram DedicatedSorts through the exact ordinary host_owner_engine factory with owner_prepare::prepare_core. Not the generic extension builder, compiler source path, word layout engine, or arbitrary ProgramView admission. Successful source preparation is a premise, not asserted by this declaration.

provenance.selection: ordinary factory PrepareDeps.prepare_core=owner_prepare::prepare_core (factory26..33); OwnerEngine::admit delegates its exact configured prepare.admit; ordinary admit uses local prepare_core atAD5.

builtins.meaning: TypeIdC associated identifiers and from_source_sort mapping only; NOT materialized TypeRowC or CtorRowExt rows in ordinary DedicatedSorts prepare_core. Dedicated check_program_view uses four implicit builtin types when is_generic=false.

rules.contract: Collect names of every Core function, parameter, Var, Let, Call and flat Core pattern binder into one distinct Rust BTreeSet<str>. Final Vec is strict Rust str Ord order, not occurrence/insertion order. NameId is index in that sorted Vec, binary searched. Shadowed equal text shares NameId; there is no alpha-renaming or normalization. Capacity checks happen when first distinct name is encountered; successful mapping is conditional on them.

Root entry is ExprId0. Expressions are entry subtree semantic preorder, then each function body subtree in source function order. Node id is next expression length before visiting children. Let:value,body; Binary:left,right; Unary:operand; If:cond,then,else; Call:arguments source order; Match:scrutinee,then arm bodies source order. Leaf Literal/Var have no children. Core child trees are uniquely owned; no sharing or deduplication is introduced.

Literal refers to its later C6 constant root; Var and Let binder use sorted name IDs; Let/Binary/Unary/If reference C1 child IDs; Call uses callee name ID and C2 argument slice; Match uses scrutinee ID, C3 arm slice and plan=None. Ordinary CoreExpr does not emit Construct.
Scan ExprId order. Only Call emits direct argument child IDs in source order into contiguous children slots, no slots for Let/Binary/If. Call.args is the corresponding normalized slice.

Scan Match expressions in ExprId order, arms in source order. Emit one pattern row per flat Core arm (PVar/PNil/PCons/PLeaf/PBranch); binders use sorted name IDs. Arm.pattern is that new row index, body is the C1 matching arm-body child ID. Match.arms is contiguous normalized slice. No wildcard/nested Constructor rows and no pattern_children are emitted by this Core grammar.

One occurrence per expression, same row index. Entry-owned expressions use owner_is_function=false,function=0; function bodies true/source function index. Derive AST path by following parent links, reverse to root-to-leaf child positions. In occurrence order append each full path to occurrence_paths, preserving repeated path segments; occurrence.path is normalized slice to its own appended path. Empty root path uses start0,len0 and appends nothing.

Functions keep source declaration order. Each function parameters append in declaration order to contiguous normalized slice, binder names use sorted NameId, sorts and return type use TypeIdC fixed builtin IDs, body points to C1 function-root expression. Empty parameters normalize slice start0,len0. No nominal table rows are inserted.

Scan Literal expressions in ExprId order. Emit a fresh literal expansion without interning/deduplication; child-before-parent nodes. UInt InRange emits U128, negative/above-u128 emits U128OutOfRange; Bool emits Bool. List emits scalar element nodes in element order, then Nil, then Cons nodes from final element backward, each field pair head,tail. Tree emits left-to-right postorder (Leaf scalar then Leaf; Branch left subtree,right subtree,Branch). Each node ID is prior constants length; append its child IDs to constant_fields in field order before node. Empty fields normalize start0,len0. marker_free false for marker; otherwise conjunction of child marker_free, vacuously true at nonmarker scalar/Nil. Rewrite Literal.constant to returned root.
len0 has start0; otherwise retain actual allocated append-start and len. No slicing to active-only expected output or post-hoc normalization.

On successful ordinary admit: profile_id2, grammar_domain DedicatedSorts, finance Absent; layout_version and field_id copied; layout_digest,bounds_digest,program_membership_digest Unselected. This is this producer identity, not an assertion of cryptographic source binding or general admission correctness.

AD5 runs prepare_core then check_program_view. Dedicated validation computes is_generic=false for these eleven empty vectors, ordinary Core rows/patterns/constants and builtin signatures; it reconstructs dedicated Core in V8, re-prepares and compares the full view including every11 vector, source paths, constants/marker flags and names. This source-derived rule is a proposed correspondence premise, not a new validator or proof that the given input has passed. Generic validation takes a separate dependency not covered by this contract.

not_values: No populated ProgramView for the selected program, afterstate, event, allocation counter, target ordinal, producer output or private expected is included. Independent role must derive its own new literal prefix after Root adopts an applicable declaration contract.

Correlation with production source and shared natural contract remains explicit; this is not independent implementation validation.
